name: Add-on popularity
query:
select 
    `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name ,
    count(`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.name) as 'Sold Count'
    
from
    `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`
join 
    `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` 
        on `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.item = `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name

group by `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Type`.name
